data.headline: Executive Director @ Lenovo | Driving Transformational Change | R&D Leader for AI Adoption
data.about:
I lead the CTO Office and SSG R&D, shaping the strategy, offerings, technology architecture infusing AI and enable the platform to realize the Services Led goals. I have over 25 years of experience in delivering IT solutions that adapt to dynamic business needs and ensure user satisfaction across diverse regions and cultures.

My core competencies include building strategy, biz adoption, hands-on in implementing relevant technology platforms that help in adopting process, change management to realize the business outcomes.  Specialized in delivering global customer service applications, knowledge management solutions. supply chain management and customer relationship management. I have successfully implemented solutions that harmonize processes, increase efficiency, and maintain local touch across different cultures and expectations.

I have also worked with global giants like Ford Motors, Toyota, Levi's, Roche Vitamins, and Unilever Plc, providing tailored information systems. As a Professional Scrum Master and a change management specialist, I am passionate about infusing technology within an organization and empowering high-performance teams.

experiences.title: Executive Director - Service Tools & IT Enablement (World Wide)
experiences.subtitle: Lenovo . undefined
experiences.caption: Mar 2018 - Aug 2023 · 5 yrs 5 mos

description.text:
Helped in exploring several proof of concepts on the Cloud Business. Successfully assisted in feasibility study to setting up the Digital Signage business(adjacent business opportunity). Solution extension in retail integration with POS solutions helping in end to end tracking & automation using iOT devices. Became an intrapreneur by investing own funds to prove that the integration with HW + Software+ Services creates value (about 200+ restaurant chains in UAE using this since 2016 and 1000+ in India)

Successfully completed a working model in integrating iOT Medical device integration through hybrid cloud & helping in remote care and telecare. Integration with EMR  using FHIR. Invested in a new age Mobile EMR integrated with Medical devices & is being used by about 40+ doctors in UAE.

Enabled the new BYOC organization to frame the service structure for all its partners in the new Cloud business.  Proposed a uberization of service model to increase reach & optimize cost.

subComponents.title: Associate Vice President - Customer Service Applications
subComponents.caption: Jan 2013 - Dec 2015 · 2 yrs 11 mos

description.text:
Exploring in transforming our Global Customer Service to become a profit center from being a cost center leveraging our IT solutions that are our competitive advantage . Assisting the global service organization in using the common KPIs across regions to optimize the operations. Improvising the global logistics platform for spares - forward & reverse logistics using intelligent IT solutions that make the planners across regions make smart decisions.

Cloud enabling Customer service applications. Co-dreaming, Co-creating Customer Service Apps involved in the last mile of customer service transactions on the cloud.

subComponents.title: Director - Global Customer Service Application Division
subComponents.caption: Jan 2009 - Jan 2013 · 4 yrs

description.text: Implemented a common customer service application platform across the major regions (EMEA, Pan America, Asia Pacific) making it the competitive advantage for Acer. More importantly, people love to use this application as it improved their daily operations. Enabled customer service organization to be agile & respond to dynamics of the market by implementing changes across the regions swiftly through this service platform. Aided the Customer service team in sharing their best practices so that the organization can leverage from the strengths through setting up the Project Management office & building cohesive workstreams across the various continents, cultures & time zones. Brought in the transparency & visibility across the teams so as to make sure the cost of customer service is in line with the company directions. Managed the development, implementation, rollout of the home grown software for the entire customer service suite through a very robust out sourced development strategy.

Helped in evaluating, planning and execution of global projects considering all world wide requirements. Worked towards bringing in technology innovation to service business. Implemented transaction systems that best suits business needs of the call center (internal /outsourced), repair centers (internal / outsourced), spares logistics (internal / outsourced) managing forward & reverse logistics. Developed some unique solutions in logistics planning & parts allocation which intelligently routed the spare parts to the right place at the right time.
